name: bishop_of_wings_sees_an_angel_die_at_the_same_moment_it_dies_itself
notes: Printed: 'Whenever an Angel you control dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.' Planar Cleansing destroys the Bishop and seat 0's Angel at the same time: a dies trigger looks back in time (CR 603.10a), so the Bishop's trigger for the Angel still happens and exactly one Spirit is created after both are dead.
